source: Department of National Defence operation histories; United Nations Secretary-General reports and The Blue Helmets (UN Digital Library); Veterans Affairs Canada
source_table: DND past-operations pages; UN documents cited by symbol (S/…, A/…) with a URL per row
unit: uniformed personnel concurrently deployed (lower and upper bound per period)
transformations: one row per mission and period; low == high where a dated figure exists, otherwise the two nearest dated figures as bounds (basis: exact | reported | inferred | bounded)
police (UNTAG's RCMP contingent) counted as uniformed personnel, as in the UN's monthly data
notes: Evidence table behind data/fiscal/peace_operations_history.csv (python -m pipeline.peace_ops_history). UN-led missions run to December 1990 only; the UN's monthly data takes over from November 1990. Categories: UN-led; NATO-led (Balkans: IFOR, SFOR, KFOR); NATO-led (Afghanistan: ISAF, then the NATO Training Mission); Other non-UN (ICSC Indochina 1954–74, ICCS Vietnam 1973, MFO Sinai). NATO deterrence deployments in Europe are not peace operations and are excluded.
